04 / INPUT AND HANDOFF

Load or export a coupon

Save the original coordinate records, estimated transform and inspection result for future downstream use. No connected station has been verified. Plane coordinates and clearances are reported in millimeters.

Load JSON or try the ring-failure example

Supply bts.r4-inert-coupon/1 JSON with separate reference and observed records. Unrecognized inputs leave your current coupon and receipt intact. Input coordinates affect the maps and results, not the dimensions of the physical 3D prop.

05 / EVIDENCE

Method, checks and references

Reference and observed landmarks use separate right-handed XY coordinate frames (x right and y up). The 180° flip about local X first reverses y in the projected plane. The solver then estimates only rotation and translation using fit landmarks; an independent landmark checks the result. Ring clearance is the ring radius minus the projected feature radius minus the measured center offset.

No firing, beam, motion inside the cabinet or manufacturing process is modeled. The bench uses abstract coordinates, not a calibrated optical or R4 model. Its mechanical flip explains the external jig only; the fitted angle describes an XY transform between records, not tilt.
